Preparing for IELTS requires thorough and focused preparation. The official IELTS by IDP app offers a range of features and resources to help you do your best on test day! 

 

Here's what you can expect from the app: 

* Watch videos: Access more than 400 videos featuring IELTS experts and test takers, providing valuable insights and tips to improve your performance. 

* Read articles: Browse through more than 150 articles offering valuable advice and tips for the IELTS test. 

* Quiz yourself: Challenge yourself with IELTS test format questions. How prepared are you for test day? 

* Register for an event: Sign up for free IELTS preparation events online or in your city to gain additional guidance and support. 

* Use the preparation checklist: Utilise the IELTS preparation checklist to ensure you cover all the necessary areas before test day.  

* Calculate your band score: Make use of the band score calculator to get an estimation of your potential band score based on your performance in different sections. 

* Understand the band score descriptors: The descriptors outline the specific criteria that examiners use to evaluate your performance in each section of the test. 

 

The app provides a FREE preparation course from Macquarie University, which includes: 

* Expert guided tutorials: Access 15+ tutorials led by experienced instructors to help you understand key concepts and strategies. 

* Practice questions and quizzes: Solve 10+ practice questions and quizzes to reinforce your learning and familiarise yourself with the test format. 

* Writing assessments: Attempt sample writing assessments and compare your responses to a model answer for a better understanding and improvement. 

*Free for 14 days, option to upgrade. 

 

The app also offers exclusive preparation options, such as: 

* 7-day preparation challenge: Sign up for the free 7-day preparation challenge to receive targeted exercises and tasks to boost your readiness. 

* Bundle offers: In certain countries, you can access discounted bundle offers for IELTS Progress Check, which provides additional practice and feedback. 

 

Additionally, the app supports your IELTS booking, allowing you to conveniently schedule your test with IDP IELTS, anywhere in the world. If you require any assistance, you can reach out to the local customer support team for guidance. 

 

After completing your test, the app allows you to access and share your results: 

* Manage results: Easily view and manage all your IELTS results directly from your mobile device. 

* Share results: Celebrate your achievements by sharing your IELTS results on your social networks. 

* Search institutions: Find global institutions and organisations that accept IELTS scores, helping you pursue your educational and career goals. 

 

IELTS is recognised as the most trusted English language testing system worldwide, and the official IELTS by IDP app aims to support test takers in their preparation journey.
